class_name: 推量-高確実性-ニホカナラナイ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

glosses: is nothing but; is none other than
patterns.usage_note: Asserts identity rather than conjecture: it strips away the alternatives and declares what something really is, or pins a result to one cause (差別にほかならない, お支えのおかげにほかなりません). に違いない answers 'is this true?'; にほかならない answers 'what is this really?', so it is unusable where the speaker is guessing. It predicates on a noun or nominalized clause, very often the fixed 〜からにほかならない, and belongs to formal and essayistic prose.

examples.ruby: 芸術[げいじゅつ]とは作者[さくしゃ]の内面[ないめん]の表現[ひょうげん]にほかならない。
examples.english: Art is nothing other than an expression of its maker's inner life.

examples.ruby: その発言[はつげん]は弱者[じゃくしゃ]に対[たい]する差別[さべつ]にほかならない。
examples.english: That remark is nothing short of discrimination against the vulnerable.

examples.ruby: 今回[こんかい]の受賞[じゅしょう]は皆様[みなさま]のお支[ささ]えのおかげにほかなりません。
examples.english: This award is thanks to your support, and nothing else.
